explanation: The theorem says a library-specific measure, `selfDualHaarAt ℚ p`, is an additive Haar measure. The measure is a scalar multiple, by a power of the absolute norm of p, of `addHaarMeasure` on the integers of the p-adic completion. Mathlib has no `selfDualHaarAt`: grep finds zero occurrences. The proof is `IsAddHaarMeasure.smul` applied to the definition. That lemma is general scalar-multiple glue and does not carry this specific result. I found no Mathlib declaration stating that a self-dual Haar measure on a p-adic completion is Haar.
